event_summary: A stacked arrangement of colored rectangular blocks changes when the upper blue block and yellow block tip and move down to the tabletop while the red block remains upright.
raw_event_description: At the start, a red rectangular block stands upright on a tabletop, a yellow rectangular block lies horizontally across its top, and a blue rectangular block stands vertically near the right side of the yellow block with an orange-and-black gripper-like object around its upper part. The arrangement remains still for many frames. Later, the orange-and-black prongs are seen above the blue block, the yellow block tips from horizontal, and the blue block tilts and moves down and to the right. The yellow and blue blocks come to rest on the tabletop to the right of the red block, while the red block remains upright.

reasons: The colored blocks are clearly visible.
The upper portions of the orange-and-black gripper-like object are cropped by the top edge of the frame.
